select lm.*, zz.dzzmc, (select group_concat(us.username) from zz_learningmeetingusers us where us.meetingId=lm.meetingId and us.usertype=1 )as recordUserNames, (select group_concat(us.username) from zz_learningmeetingusers us where us.meetingId=lm.meetingId and us.usertype=3 )as attendUserNames from zz_learningmeeting lm inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on lm.dzzdm=zz.DZZDM where 1=1
and zz.DZZDM like concat('%',#{dzzdm},'%')
and lm.meetingName like concat('%',#{meetingName},'%')
and lm.meetingId in(select meetingId from zz_learningmeetingusers us where us.username =#{recordUserName} and us.usertype=1)
and lm.location like concat('%',#{location},'%')
and meetingDate >= date_format(#{beginTime},"%Y%m%d")
and meetingDate < date_add(date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d'),interval 1 day)
order by lm.meetingDate desc

select p.ZZQKXXBS, p.DZZMC,fb.ZZLB, fb.JCZZFL, p.JLDZZRQ, p.SCYTDZB, p.KZPYRQ, p.JSPYRQ, p.YL01, p.YL02, p.YL03, p.YL04, p.YL05,z.HZMC as ZZLBMC,j.HZMC as JCZZFLMC, p.DZZDM NODECODE,SUBSTR(p.DZZDM,1,LENGTH(p.DZZDM)-3) PARENTCODE, ifnull(fb.ZGRS,0) as ZGRS,fb.LDJTJC,bz.LDJTDXRQ as SCHJSJ,bz.GJJMRQ, ifnull(fb.DYZS,0) as USERCOUNT, pmettings.DZZDM,ifnull(pmettings.m1,0) m1, ifnull(pmettings.m2,0) m2, ifnull(pmettings.m3,0) m3, ifnull(pmettings.m4,0) m4, ifnull(pmettings.m5,0) m5, ifnull(pmettings.m6,0) m6, ifnull(pmettings.m7,0) m7, ifnull(pmettings.m8,0) m8, ifnull(pmettings.m9,0) m9, ifnull(pmettings.m10,0) m10, ifnull(pmettings.m11,0) m11, ifnull(pmettings.m12,0) m12, ifnull(pmettings.yearTotal,0) yearTotal
from ZZ_ZZQKXX p left join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on p.DZZDM=fb.DZZDM left join zzzd_zzlbdmnew z on fb.ZZLB = z.BM left join zzzd_jczzflnew j on fb.JCZZFL = j.BM left join ZZ_BZJCXX bz on p.DZZDM = bz.DZZDM and bz.LDJTJC = fb.LDJTJC left join ZZ_ZZQKXX dw on SUBSTR(p.DZZDM,1,12)=dw.DZZDM left join VM_PARTYGROUP partyGroup on dw.DZZDM = partyGroup.DZZDM left join( select p.DZZDM, sum(mettings.m1) m1, sum(mettings.m2) m2, sum(mettings.m3) m3, sum(mettings.m4) m4, sum(mettings.m5) m5, sum(mettings.m6) m6, sum(mettings.m7) m7, sum(mettings.m8) m8, sum(mettings.m9) m9, sum(mettings.m10) m10, sum(mettings.m11) m11, sum(mettings.m12) m12, sum(mettings.yearTotal) yearTotal from ZZ_ZZQKXX p inner join( select dzzdm, sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m1", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m2", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m3", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m4", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m5", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m6", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '7' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m7", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '8' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m8", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '9' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m9", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m10", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m11", sum(CASE month(meetingDate) WHEN '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "m12", sum(CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "yearTotal" from zz_learningmeeting lm where date_format(lm.meetingDate, '%Y') = #{year} group by dzzdm )mettings on mettings.DZZDM like concat('',p.DZZDM,'%') group by p.DZZDM )pmettings on p.DZZDM=pmettings.DZZDM where 1=1 and p.DZZDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%') and fb.ZZLB in(300)
and p.DZZDM like concat('%',#{dzzdm},'%')
order by PARENTCODE,NODECODE

select lm.*, zz.dzzmc, (select group_concat(us.username) from zz_learningmeetingusers us where us.meetingId=lm.meetingId and us.usertype=1 )as recordUserNames, (select group_concat(us.username) from zz_learningmeetingusers us where us.meetingId=lm.meetingId and us.usertype=3 )as attendUserNames from zz_learningmeeting lm inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on lm.dzzdm=zz.DZZDM where 1=1
and lm.meetingId in(select meetingId from zz_learningmeetingusers us where us.userid =#{attendUserid} and us.usertype=1)
and date_format(lm.meetingDate,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{day}
and meetingDate >= date_format(#{beginTime},"%Y%m%d")
order by lm.meetingDate desc
